verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is a speech API platform, so first-party background automations (scheduled or triggered workflows that run unattended) are a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no such capability. The closest item, workspace-admin tokens for programmatic project and key management (docs-18), is a developer building block that earns no credit. Batch processing jobs are one-off API calls, not user-configured recurring automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
